version.changelog: Remove file read and localhost defaults to fix security scanner flags

llm.summary: The skill largely matches its stated purpose (image generation via Pixmind) and only requests one API key, but there are packaging/integration oddities and non-obvious domains that warrant verification before use.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, required env var (PIXMIND_API_KEY), and included helper scripts all align with a Pixmind image-generation skill. The code implements text2img and img2img flows and task polling as described.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md instructs only to call the Pixmind API and poll task status; it doesn't ask the agent to read local files or unrelated environment variables. However, the docs explicitly reference two domains — aihub-admin.aimix.pro (API gateway) and chatmix.top (CDN) — which are not the pixmind.io domain shown as the homepage; you should verify these endpoints are legitimately associated with Pixmind before providing your API key.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is present (instruction-only install), so nothing arbitrary is downloaded or written to disk by an installer step. The package includes helper JS files which will run with node if invoked; there are no embedded archives or external installers.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single credential (PIXMIND_API_KEY) is required and declared as the primary credential — appropriate for an API-client skill. No unrelated secrets or system config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill does not request elevated privileges or always-on persistence (always: false). Autonomous invocation is allowed by default (disable-model-invocation: false) but that is the platform default and not by itself a red flag.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says (call a Pixmind API to generate/edit images) and only asks for one API key — which is normal. Before installing, verify two things: (1) Confirm the API base aihub-admin.aimix.pro and the CDN domain chatmix.top are legitimate Pixmind endpoints by checking Pixmind's official docs or contacting Pixmind support. Unfamiliar endpoints can be legitimate CDNs/gateways but should be verified. (2) Note a minor packaging bug: image-generate.js imports APP_KEY but the helper exports API_KEY; that indicates sloppy packaging and may cause runtime failures. If you proceed, restrict the PIXMIND_API_KEY to an account with minimal privileges, avoid reusing a high-privilege key, and consider testing in an environment where leaks (if any) would have limited impact. If you need higher assurance, ask the publisher for source provenance or an official repo link and confirm the domains used match their documentation. Overall rating: suspicious (medium confidence) because of the domain mismatch and the packaging/import inconsistency; not enough evidence to call it malicious but verify before use.
